apps.name: WearBridge
apps.subtitle: Wear OS to iOS Notification & Battery Bridge
apps.versionDescription: Version 1.1: Robust watch battery gathering and live BLE telemetry dispatch, companion service auto-rediscovery, write queue watchdog timer, and Wear OS battery status UI.
apps.localizedDescription: Bridge your Samsung Galaxy Watch / Wear OS watch to your iPhone. Enables ANCS notification mirroring, quick replies, native iOS battery widget integration, and health telemetry.
